[Page 1]
Introduction to Linear Algebra
Lecture 3: Matrix Multiplication
1. Definition
The product of an m by n matrix A and an n by p matrix B
is an m by p matrix C. Each entry of C is the dot product
of a row of A and a column of B.
2. Properties
Matrix multiplication is associative: (AB)C = A(BC).
In general it is not commutative: AB is not always equal to BA.
The identity matrix I satisfies AI = IA = A.
3. Example
Multiplying a 2 by 3 matrix by a 3 by 2 matrix gives a 2 by 2 matrix.
Homework: exercises 3.1 to 3.8 on page 42.

[Page 1]
第三章 细胞的结构与功能
第一节 细胞膜
细胞膜主要由脂质和蛋白质组成，还含有少量的糖类。
细胞膜具有选择透过性，能够控制物质进出细胞。
第二节 细胞核
细胞核是遗传信息库，是细胞代谢和遗传的控制中心。
染色质主要由脱氧核糖核酸和蛋白质组成。
第三节 细胞器
线粒体是有氧呼吸的主要场所，叶绿体是光合作用的场所。
课后思考：比较植物细胞与动物细胞在结构上的异同。
